description: Use for reading a web page as clean markdown for an LLM or agent (url to markdown, reader, html to text): POST {url, max_chars} and get {title, markdown, chars, source_url}. Returns the paid x402 request for your input (POST /v1/doc/read, $0.005 per call; schema linked). POST that JSON body to the URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.

max_chars.description: longest markdown to return; longer pages are cut and marked truncated

url.description: public http or https page to read, e.g. https://example.com/

name: doc_read
title: Doc read
